### ObolClient {#ObolClient}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag">interface</span> <code class="sdk-qual">ObolClient</code></div>

The client: every module bound to one chain, viem clients and API.

```ts sdk-signature
interface ObolClient {
  chain: ObolChain;
  cluster: ClusterModule;
  deposits: DepositsModule;
  ovm: OvmModule;
  splits: SplitsModule;
  setup: SetupModule;
  incentives: IncentivesModule;
  exits: ExitsModule;
  terms: TermsModule;
  withdrawals: WithdrawalsModule;
  send: (
    prepared: AnyPrepared,
    options?: SendOptions,
  ) => Promise<Sent>;
  experimental: ExperimentalModule;
}
```

### ObolClientConfig {#ObolClientConfig}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag">interface</span> <code class="sdk-qual">ObolClientConfig</code></div>

```ts sdk-signature
interface ObolClientConfig {
  chain: Chain;
  publicClient: PublicClient;
  walletClient?: WalletClient;
  api?:
    | {
        baseUrl?: string;
        timeoutMs?: number;
        allowLocal?: boolean;
      }
    | false;
}
```

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--fields">

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <code>chain</code> | <span class="sdk-type">Chain</span> | viem Chain: mainnet or Hoodi (Gnosis / Sepolia for cluster files only). |
| <code>publicClient</code> | <span class="sdk-type">PublicClient</span> |  |
| <code>walletClient?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">WalletClient</span> | Needed for EIP-712 signatures and `send`. |
| <code>api?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">{ baseUrl?: string; timeoutMs?: number; allowLocal?: boolean } &#124; false</span> | Default: the Obol API at api.obol.tech, 30 s timeout. `false`: chain only. `baseUrl` must be an Obol host; with `allowLocal: true` it may also be `http(s)://localhost[:port]` or `http(s)://127.0.0.1[:port]` (a local obol-api). EIP-712 signatures are sent to that host as bearer tokens, so any other host is refused. |

</div>

<p class="sdk-see"><a href="https://github.com/ObolNetwork/obol-sdk/blob/080fa554c999b11c014f3f09be26274014ded0b9/src/clientContext.ts#L23">source</a></p>

interface Context {

| <code>viemChain?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">Chain</span> | The viem Chain the client was built with (`createObolClient({ chain })`). `send` passes it to `sendTransaction`, so viem re-checks the wallet chain at send time. | <code>api</code> | <span class="sdk-type">ObolApi &#124; null</span> | null when the client was built with `api: false`. |
